title: Sales By Customer exports name the Sales Type selection
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. With both options selected, export the PDF and read the filter line.
  2. Export the CSV and read the filter line.
  3. Select only Part Sales in the Sales Type filter.
  4. Export the PDF and read the filter line.
  5. Export the CSV and read the filter line.
  6. Select only Service Sales in the Sales Type filter.
  7. Export the PDF and read the filter line.
  8. Export the CSV and read the filter line.
  9. Untick both options.
  10. Click Export.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it reads "Sales Type: All Sales".
  • Step 2: it reads "Sales Type: All Sales".
  • Step 3: only Part Sales is ticked.
  • Step 4: it reads "Sales Type: Part Sales only".
  • Step 5: it reads "Sales Type: Part Sales only".
  • Step 6: only Service Sales is ticked.
  • Step 7: it reads "Sales Type: Service Sales only".
  • Step 8: it reads "Sales Type: Service Sales only".
  • Step 9: no option is ticked.
  • Step 10: "Empty export" shows and no file is made.

The Sales By Customer spec, version 21 (6 Oct 2026, S3-R7, S15-R10 and S18-R10), still makes a file with a "No sales" line when no option is selected. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 for the PRD on both reports (answer 27, quoted below): Export shows "Empty export" and makes no file. This case follows PRD version 10.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R9: “The filter line at the top of every PDF and CSV export of Sales By Customer reads "Sales Type: All Sales", "Sales Type: Part Sales only", or "Sales Type: Service Sales only". With no option selected, Export shows "Empty export" and makes no file. Any other export with no rows still downloads a file with the headings and no rows, as today.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 27: “27. (a) as the feature spec on both reports. Other empty results still download a file with headings and no rows, unchanged.”
